product_metadata.title: Zenna Home 2130NN Shower Tension Pole Caddy, Satin Nickel
features: EASY TO INSTALL: Fits in corner of tub or shower, with no tools needed for installation

FITS IN YOUR SHOWER: Tension mechanism allows for easy height adjustment to fit in spaces with up to an 8 feet, 1 inch, standard ceiling height (Note that for ceiling heights from 60 to 70. 5 inches, and from 81 to 91. 5 inches, one of the poles needs to be cut; easy-to-follow instructions are included)
RUST-RESISTANT FINISH: Rich satin nickel finish is rust resistant
ATTRACTIVE AND RUST RESISTANT: Oil rubbed bronze finish looks great and resists rust
EXTENSION POLES AVAILABLE FOR TALLER HEIGHTS: For ceiling heights greater than 8 feet, 1 inch, extension poles are available directly from the manufacturer
description: The Zenna Home Tension Corner Pole Caddy instantly creates valuable storage for bath items in the corner of your shower. With four baskets, including one deep basket for custom storage of tall items, this rust-resistant shower caddy has plenty of room for shampoo, conditioner and other toiletry items. Assembly is easy. The caddy’s adjustable tension pole mechanism allows it to fit in spaces up to a standard bathroom ceiling of 8 feet, 1 inch high.
